question: What follows if the goddess-consciousness is clearly full and unlimited?
premises: The meaning of the thirty has been explained as an enclosing union.
The goddess-consciousness may be understood as full and unlimited.
This understanding is presented as a clear condition.
inference: If goddess-consciousness is clearly full and unlimited, the enclosing structure of the thirty is fully intelligible.
uncertainties: The referent of triṃśaka is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Thus this enclosing union, the meaning of the thirty, has been explained. If the goddess-consciousness is clearly full and unlimited, then it is so.
